--- NOTE: 2 The Lens.md ---
# 2 The Lens

The lens bends light into a beam.[^1]
A beam carries farther than a glow.[^2]
Obviously, a keeper can take no notice of the lens on a clear night.[^3]
On a foggy night it is no help at all.[^4]
It uses rings of prisms instead of one thick glass.[^5]

[^1]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#The Lens]] "The lens bends light into a beam."
[^2]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#The Lens]] "A beam carries farther than a glow."
[^3]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#The Lens]] "Obviously, a keeper can take no notice of the lens on a clear night."
[^4]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#The Lens]] "On a foggy night it is no help at all."
[^5]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#The Lens]] "uses rings of prisms instead of one thick glass"
